notes.title: Fixed! Multiplayer and Scores are back.
notes.content:
- Thank you to all those that recorded videos of the game, upon my youtube searches and watches, it was made aware to me that the Steam version of the game had some issues, and with people still playing DMH its embarrassing to not have it working as intended!

- It took the whole day, but the problem was slowly narrowed down, tweaked, adjusted, restarted, found out it may be other reasons, rinse and repeat.

- The Steam version uses the old website URL for scores and multiplayer, the old URL was auto directing to the new URL  (as intended!).
However some update over the years, maybe related to php/cpanel/servers, mostly out of my control, meant the POST data was lost whilst it converted the URL from the old, to the new.  (im sure it used to work fine?)
This meant blank info was basically received server side, and thus wouldn't show you highscores or onto multiplayer.

- If you do intend to play online, try grab a friend, its a sandbox multiplayer, you are the scarer to whoever else joins, and them to you.
This multiplayer style was basically created as i noticed many people complained during videos that they could do better scares, well nows your chance.  ;)

DMH is a very old game now and its good to see people still play, thanks for reading, and most of all playing  :)

notes.title: Steam update 3: Multiplayer and GUI Tweaks
notes.content:
- - - Change Log - - -

12 Feb 2015:
Various Map and GUI adjustments
Player max now 64 (lobby)
Top 50 scores show instead of 100, to load faster
Thinner player collider on multiplayer
Events do not delete themselves after set time if triggered
Added backup quitting incase no network to disconnect from
Fixed buttons and added Low quality setting to multiplayer maps
Floor falling fixes in multiplayer

2 Feb 2015 :
German and Japanese translations improved (thanks Shervrar and Shinji-coo-K)
Added Multiplayer / Chapter 4  (V1.0)  ** 
Slightly longer sprint and faster recovery time
Layout aspect ratio size improvements throughout
Final form Sui only shows after completing chapter 3
Back button appears sooner
Chapters scoring adjusted
Credits updated
Grammar fixes
Skip button added to intros (chapter 1 and 4)
Touch screen pause button hides on PC version
Minor map adjustments
Footsteps and Traps stay spawned for longer
Chapter 4 map slightly smaller so you can find players easier
Chapters 1 2 and 3 converted to multiplayer and playable


** Oculus rift and mobile versions of chapter 4 / multiplayer will be released after feedback from the PC/Mac/Linux versions.

notes.title: Multiplayer will be Free!
notes.content:
Trading cards, badges, emotes, backgrounds etc have been released, i see some of you have already been getting them!  ^_^

http://steamcommunity.com/market/search?q=disillusions+manga+horror#p1_default_desc

And the multiplayer, this will not be paid DLC like some have thought, it will be treated as an update to the game, free.


Thank you for your interest, hope you enjoy! 
- Steve.
